end.summary:
Practised showing 11–14 as one group of ten and some more ones.
Saanvi identified 11 as ten sticks and one more.
Saanvi identified 14 as ten and four more, then restated it as one ten and some ones.
Saanvi began explaining 13 as ten and three more before the lesson ended.
Teach-back was not completed; Saanvi said they felt tired and wanted to cycle.
end.parentNote: Asha practised building numbers with one group of ten sticks and extra ones. Saanvi used this method for 11 and 14, and their explanation of 14 was clarified during the lesson; 13 was started but not completed. At home, try making 11–20 with ten objects in one group and adding the extra objects, stopping after a few examples if Saanvi feels tired.
